nom: Eucerin Radiant Tone Night Cream Dark Spot Corrector

avis.texte: It's a great product to use if you're gonna use it solo I do not recommend to use along with other daily moisturizers or over your foundation since it clumps up everything and you have to wash your face again.

You ruined a perfectly good and possibly effective product and put a horrid scent in it! WHY? There are millions of people who can't tolerate fragrance of any kind, especially synthetic ones. The scent in this product is SO strong and heavy. I can't use it.
Like this night cream; however the fragrance is an issue. There should be a fragrance free option.
Good consistency & a little goes along way. This product does have a hint of perfume like smell to it but it was suggested to use per my doctor.

avis.titre: Fragrance is a deal breaker… bummer
avis.texte: I was excited to try the radiant tone night cream and dual serum for my hyperpigmentation. I checked your website for product ingredients, and did not see fragrance listed. However I tried them both and found they DID have fragrance, which was both unpleasant and gave me an allergic reaction. I hope you will consider coming out with a fragrance-free version, as many people have fragrance preferences, sensitivity or allergic reactions to added fragrance like myself. I'm quite disappointed!

avis.titre: Strong fragrance is a deal breaker
avis.texte: The product makes my skin feel great but the perfume is a deal breaker for me. If you offer a fragrance-free Radiant Tone line in the future, I'll be back.

I've used many pigment inhibitors over the years due to Fitzpatrick level 4 skin. This works! You can get away with using small amounts & it still works. Watch for sales & use coupons. Ulta, please never stop carrying this product.

the plus side is that this product doesn't make me break out or get dry patches. the downside is the scent. it's very strong and reminds me of old lady perfume from Avon. I'll continue using it until I find "the one".

Very nice and lightweight but moisturizing. I personally love the fragrance and do not find it at all overpowering or offensive. It is light, a bit floral, and clean. I cannot yet comment on reduction in dark spots as I've just started using
This product works, but oh my goodness! Why the overpowering fragrance?!?!

I am beyond shocked that this product has a fragrance. Fragrance irritates skin and Eucerin knows this! I have come to rely on this brand to be one of the best for my skin. Not any longer. I immediately washed my face after applying and threw the sample away. I will let my dermatologist know NOT to recommend this product! And I will definitely rethink my use of this brand going forward. So disappointing!

I love the results but the fragrance is awful and unnecessary! Please make a fragrance free version for those of us with sensitive skin and sensitivities to scent . It does nothing for the health of skin, and in many cases can cause issues.

avis.titre: rich and thick yet it absorbs quickly
avis.texte: feels heavenly and yet it absorbs well. I like this as part of the set and it works well with the serum too

avis.titre: Fragrance is toooo strong and nauseating
avis.texte: Fragrance is toooo strong and nauseating. Can this be fragrance free. ?

This is a very effective lotion for fading hyperpigmentation. I saw results within a month. On the down side, the fragrance is not pleasant: think lemon Windex. I'm sticking with this product for the time being, but there may come a point where I have to move on to a better scented or unscented fade product.

avis.titre: Light to the skin, cutie fragrance, love it!
avis.texte: Due to the comments, about the scent, I was afraid I'll super regret it. I thought would be heavy. But once applied it, I loved the smell! Became a fan of everything it is. Also, is not greasy, it's light to my skin. A pretty additon to my Eucerin collection. Mainly, beauty night routine. I just started a week ago, if it doesn't do the job, welp, still need to hydrate my face
This night cream makes my skin very hydrated and glowly. It has a cooling sensation when you put it on your face. Makes my skin feel smooth and soft .

avis.titre: Fragrance is very strong, almost unbearable.
avis.texte: I've been using this product for the past couple nights now. Feels very hydrating, and I am looking forward to seeing if it makes a dent in treating my melasma. I am finding it a little difficult to get past the strong fragrance. I'll probably continue using this product until the bottle finishes, but I probably won't be repurchasing. Is it possible to reformulate this product without that odor?

I just received this today... so i havent smelled it havent used it so once i do there will be reviews. Let me say, i havent found ANYTHING that works on my dark spots. Im hopeful this works, but wouldnt be shocked if it didnt. I bought the full bottle, didnt get a sample. Thanks

Easy to apply, absorbed well, & the 'lotiony' smell wasn't overpowering. It worked well for the price & lightened quite a few of my acne scars. However, it caused dry / rough patches on sensitive areas when it transferred (nose, around my lips, undereye). I recommend giving it a try, but it's just not for me.

I use perfume every day and scented lotions. The fragrance and chemicals are so incredibly overpowering that I could not use with a clear conscious and returned it. I keep checking back to see if they have reformulated. This one from Eucerin boggles the mind. I don't have a lot of confidence in some of these reviews being authentic.
I really enjoyed this product. It's exactly as advertised, it left my skin so soft and radiant, with a little less freckles. I personally choose to cover mine so it made makeup a breeze!
Eucerin Radiant Tone Night Cream Dark Spot Corrector was easy to use

This cream is very moisturizing and feels great on the skin. It works well to fade dark spots. However, I'm not a big fan of added fragrance in skincare products for the face and would personally prefer a fragrance-free option.
It's is a good moisturizer. I don't need any change in my skin tone. It still looks the same to me
This product kept my skin feeling great! Soft and hydrated all night long.
Huge help with my dry skin and not oily at all definitely will keep up with!
i really enjoyed the consistency of this cream and how a little went a long way it also didn't leave my face feeling greasy

I've been using this product for a few weeks now and I have to say that I definitely see a difference between when I first started using it and now. My skin looks more even toned. It feels nice too. I personally haven't experienced any issues with irritation or any negative side effects. I'm very happy with the results and do plan to keep it in my skincare routine. *I did receive one unit of this item for free in exchange for my feedback*
This product left my skin feeling nourished and fresh. My skin looked young and hydrated and felt that way too!!! This is a new staple in my skin care routine. Thanks!!
I love it! It's easy to apply and you don't have to use much. It works very well and I'll continue to use it.
This cream is the best! It smells very good and it works like a charm! The only bad thing is I went into the store to find it and only a couple stores have it.

I got a free moisturizer from pinchme and have tried it for over a month now and I enjoy it. It comes in a opaque bottle. I like that it isn't drying to the skin and actually helps lighten the dark spots. I am definitely purchasing it after
I recieved this as a free sample in exchange for an honest review. I did like this as a night cream. I noticed my spots would lighten up after using it for a couple weeks.
Doesn't have a gross, chemical smell like most facial products and is gentle but strong!
Really helped my skin glow and also helped with a lot of dark spots and lines

I have used Eucerin products a number of times and I feel like they're underrated. The price point is great and their products actually work. I used the Dark Spot Corrector for about a month. I applied it at night after washing my face. It felt rich but not greasy and had a pleasant scent. I do have one small dark spot on my face and this helped reduce the pigment. My face felt moisturized and in the morning it felt fresh and supple. I will be purchasing it in the future once I run out.
I got a free sample of this product. It made skin feel and look good. Has a good scent. Works good.

This is a good product. It applied smoothly and my skin absorbed it. Didn't have a strong smell of white cast. Felt my face was hydrated. Didn't notice anything changing but I still haven't finished the entire bottle yet.
It's really great for night-time! I feel like it has firmed and brightened up my skin, and it sinks into the skin without leaving an oily residue. I also love the easy pump packaging.
The consistency is nice. I haven't noticed a difference in dark spots yet, but that could change with time. The one thing I'm not keen on is the strong scent. Received this item for free.
Eucerin is very effective for skin care, I have seen positive changes of using this product.
I received this free Eucerin Radiant Tone Night Cream Dark Spot Corrector . It works great on my dark spot, it's gentle on my dry skin doesn't dry out , but I see some good results in 2 weeks.

avis.titre: Not the right product for me
avis.texte: I was hoping this night cream would help with the dark circles under my eyes but after trying it for a few weeks under my eyes I haven't noticed a difference. I think I just need more sleep at nights. I'm thankful for being allowed to try this product even if it wasn't a good fit for me.
I really liked it, it helped improve the appearance of my skin and visibly reduce my spots, it feels very soft on the skin and has a very fresh scent.
This goes on nicely and left my face feeling smooth by morning. I am definitely seeing some results after 4 weeks of use.

avis.titre: Makes My Skin Look Brighter And More Radiant
avis.texte: I like this night cream because it's lightweight, yet very effective at reducing the look of my dark spots. The formula is a lightweight cream that has a light, pleasant scent and quickly absorbs into my skin without feeling heavy or greasy. I apply it on my face and neck in the evenings before bedtime, and in the morning my skin is more radiant and youthful looking. I highly recommend this product for anyone who wants to improve their dark spots and more radiant skin.
I'm sensitive to scents (perfume, hair products, etc) & this borders on too smelly, like perfumed sunscreen. It does fade my dark spots though. Try it, but be aware of the scent.

I got this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. This cream is very moisturizing and feels really good on my skin. I noticed a difference in my dark marks after only 2 weeks of use, they seemed much lighter and had less texture.

I received this product for free to review and all thoughts are my own, based off my experience. I absolutely loved this cream! Smooth application, smells nice, and i do see a noticeable difference in a couple dark spots. Will continue buying long term.
Good product to have for my skin feels good an other thing to add to my shopping list

I struggle with dark spots under my eyes from stress and lack of sleep. As a nurse , student & mom this product was great at helping give my skin a more "refreshing" look & correct the age & lack of sleep spots on my face! My eyes looked more refreshed in the morning, it's exactly what I needed!
Safe to use. Great fragrance. Starting to see results. Will add to my night time routine.

I received this product for free for review. I was pretty impressed with this face lotion.
